title: Introduction
body:
Welcome to Galleria Enterprises ("Galleria Enterprises," "Galleria," "we," "us," or "our").

We respect the privacy of our customers, sellers, business partners, and website visitors. Protecting personal information and maintaining transparency about how it is collected, used, stored, shared, and protected are important parts of operating our online marketplace.

This Privacy Policy explains our approach to personal information when individuals visit our website, create accounts, browse products, purchase merchandise, register as sellers, communicate with customer support, or otherwise interact with our services.

Our marketplace may connect independent sellers with customers and provide tools for product listings, purchasing, order management, customer communication, and related commercial activities.

By using our services, you acknowledge that you have been provided with this Privacy Policy. Where applicable law requires consent for specific processing activities, we will request that consent separately.

This Privacy Policy applies to our website, https://galleriaenterprisess.com/, and related services that reference this policy.

title: Information We Collect
body:
We may collect personal information directly from users, automatically through their interactions with our services, or from authorized third parties.

The categories of information we collect depend on the services and features a person uses.

### 2.1 Personal Identification Information

When you register for an account, place an order, contact support, or interact with our services, we may collect:

- Full name
- First and last name
- Email address
- Telephone number
- Billing and shipping addresses
- Country, city, state, or province
- Postal or ZIP code
- Account username
- Customer account identifiers

We collect information that is reasonably necessary for providing our services and fulfilling legitimate business requirements.

### 2.2 Account Registration Information

When users create accounts, we may process information such as:

- Registration details
- Account preferences
- Authentication credentials
- Account verification status
- Account activity and settings
- Login and security records
- Password reset requests

Passwords should be protected using appropriate industry-standard password hashing methods rather than stored as readable text.

### 2.3 Order and Transaction Information

When customers purchase products through Galleria Enterprises, we may process:

- Product names and quantities
- Shopping cart details
- Order numbers and transaction identifiers
- Purchase dates
- Order totals and currencies
- Payment status
- Shipping and delivery addresses
- Delivery instructions
- Refund and return records
- Customer service correspondence
- Order fulfillment information

This information supports order processing, delivery, dispute resolution, accounting, and customer service.

### 2.4 Payment Information

Where online payments are available, payment information may be collected and processed by authorized third-party payment service providers.

Depending on the payment method, we may receive limited transaction information, such as a payment reference number, payment status, billing details, or a masked card identifier.

We do not require customers to disclose full card details to our customer service representatives.

The handling of complete payment card information depends on the payment services actually integrated with our platform. Any statement about whether Galleria Enterprises stores card numbers must accurately reflect those integrations.

### 2.5 Seller and Merchant Information

When individuals or businesses register as sellers, we may collect:

- Seller's full name
- Business or store name
- Email address and telephone number
- Business location and registered address
- Company registration information
- Tax identification details where required
- Authorized representative information
- Identity verification documents where necessary
- Banking or payout information
- Product listings and inventory records
- Transaction and sales histories
- Seller account verification records
- Customer order fulfillment information

Seller verification documents may include government-issued identification, where permitted and necessary for legitimate verification, fraud prevention, payment compliance, or legal obligations.

Access to sensitive seller information should be restricted to authorized personnel and service providers who require it for approved purposes.

### 2.6 Automatically Collected Information

When users interact with our website, we or our authorized service providers may collect technical and usage information, including:

- IP address
- Browser type and version
- Device type
- Operating system
- Pages visited
- Referring websites
- Access dates and times
- Session activity
- Website performance information
- Security and error logs
- Cookie identifiers

This information may be used for website functionality, performance monitoring, fraud prevention, and service improvements.

title: How We Use Personal Information
body:
We may use personal information for the following purposes:

**Account Management:** To register accounts, authenticate users, maintain account preferences, and provide account-related services.

**Order Processing:** To confirm purchases, manage transactions, process refunds, and communicate about orders.

**Shipping and Delivery:** To share necessary delivery information with sellers, logistics companies, and shipping providers.

**Seller Management:** To register merchants, verify eligible sellers, manage listings, track sales, and administer seller operations.

**Customer Support:** To respond to inquiries, investigate complaints, process requests, and resolve disputes.

**Security and Fraud Prevention:** To identify suspicious activity, protect accounts, investigate misuse, and enforce marketplace policies.

**Website Improvement:** To understand usage patterns, troubleshoot issues, improve accessibility, and maintain platform reliability.

**Marketing:** To communicate promotional offers, product updates, and relevant information where permitted by law and user preferences.

**Legal Compliance:** To comply with applicable laws, valid legal requests, recordkeeping obligations, and regulatory requirements.

We will not use personal information for materially incompatible purposes without providing any notice or obtaining any consent required by applicable law.

title: Legal Basis for Processing
body:
Where applicable privacy laws require a legal basis for processing personal data, Galleria Enterprises will identify and rely on an appropriate basis.

These may include:

- **Contractual Necessity:** Processing information required to provide requested products, services, or account functionality.
- **Legal Obligations:** Maintaining records and complying with applicable legal requirements.
- **Legitimate Interests:** Protecting our platform, preventing fraud, improving services, and managing business operations, subject to applicable safeguards.
- **Consent:** Processing information for activities requiring permission, such as certain marketing communications or nonessential tracking technologies.

Where consent is the legal basis, users may withdraw it through an available preference mechanism or by contacting us. Withdrawal does not affect processing that was lawful before consent was withdrawn.

title: Cookies and Tracking Technologies
body:
Cookies are small data files that websites place on a user's browser or device.

Galleria Enterprises may use cookies and similar technologies for the following purposes, depending on the tools active on the website.

### Essential Cookies

These support necessary website features, including account authentication, shopping cart functionality, security, and session management.

### Functional Cookies

These may remember preferences such as selected language, website settings, or shopping preferences.

### Analytics Cookies

If analytics services are enabled, these may help us understand website traffic, visitor behavior, and technical performance.

### Advertising Cookies

If advertising or remarketing technologies are enabled, they may help measure marketing campaigns or provide relevant advertisements.

Where applicable law requires permission, nonessential cookies and tracking technologies will be subject to the required consent controls.

Users may also manage certain cookies through their browser settings. Disabling essential cookies may affect website functionality.

A separate Cookie Policy or preference center may provide further details about particular technologies, their providers, and retention periods.

title: Sharing Information with Third Parties
body:
We may share personal information with authorized third parties when reasonably necessary to operate our services.

Such recipients may include:

**Marketplace Sellers:** Sellers may receive customer information necessary to fulfill purchases, including names, delivery addresses, order details, and contact information relevant to order completion.

**Payment Service Providers:** Payment processors may handle payment authorization, processing, refunds, and fraud screening.

**Shipping and Logistics Providers:** Delivery companies may receive information necessary to transport and deliver purchased products.

**Hosting and Technology Providers:** Service providers may process data to host, maintain, secure, or support our website.

**Professional Advisers:** Lawyers, accountants, auditors, and similar professionals may receive relevant information when necessary for legitimate business or legal purposes.

**Government and Regulatory Authorities:** Information may be disclosed where legally required or permitted, including in response to valid legal processes.

**Corporate Transactions:** Information may be transferred or disclosed in connection with an actual or proposed merger, acquisition, restructuring, financing, or sale of business assets, subject to applicable law.

We seek to limit disclosures to information reasonably necessary for the relevant purpose.

Independent marketplace sellers and payment providers may have their own privacy obligations and policies. Users should review those policies where relevant.

title: Customer and Seller Privacy
body:
Galleria Enterprises operates a marketplace that may involve multiple parties with different responsibilities.

### Customer Information

Customer details may be made available to relevant sellers only when necessary for legitimate marketplace operations, such as processing orders, arranging delivery, handling returns, or resolving customer service issues.

Sellers should not use customer information for unrelated advertising, unauthorized disclosure, or purposes inconsistent with applicable law and marketplace requirements.

### Seller Information

Seller account information may be used for registration, account verification, product management, payment administration, legal compliance, and fraud prevention.

Certain seller business information, including store names, product descriptions, public business contact information, and store profiles, may be displayed to marketplace visitors where the relevant features are enabled.

Sensitive verification information should not be displayed publicly.

### Seller Responsibilities

Sellers are expected to protect customer information, restrict access to authorized individuals, and handle personal information according to applicable laws and their contractual responsibilities.

Where sellers independently determine how customer information is used, they may be independently responsible for that processing.

title: Data Security
body:
Protecting personal information is a priority for Galleria Enterprises.

We aim to use appropriate administrative, technical, and organizational safeguards based on the sensitivity of the information and the risks involved.

Such safeguards may include, where implemented:

- Encrypted communications using HTTPS/TLS
- Appropriate password hashing
- Access controls and account authorization
- Restricted administrative permissions
- Secure database configurations
- Security logging and monitoring
- Regular software updates
- Backup and recovery procedures
- Vulnerability management
- Fraud detection mechanisms
- Access restrictions for sensitive records

Security controls should be reviewed and improved as technology, risks, and legal requirements evolve.

Although we take data protection seriously, no online platform, electronic transmission method, or data storage system can guarantee absolute security.

Users should use strong, unique passwords and avoid sharing their account credentials.

If an actual or suspected security incident affects personal information, Galleria Enterprises will investigate and provide notifications when required by applicable law.

title: Data Storage and Retention
body:
We retain personal information for as long as reasonably necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this Privacy Policy, unless applicable law requires or permits a different period.

Retention periods may depend on:

- The duration of an active account
- The completion of purchases or transactions
- Accounting and tax obligations
- Fraud prevention requirements
- Customer service needs
- Seller verification requirements
- Legal disputes or investigations
- Applicable statutory retention obligations

When information is no longer required, we will take appropriate steps to delete, anonymize, or securely archive it, subject to legal and operational requirements.

Deleting an account may not result in the immediate deletion of transaction records that must be retained for lawful purposes.

Specific retention periods should be documented in Galleria Enterprises' internal data retention schedule.

title: International Data Transfers
body:
Galleria Enterprises may provide services to customers or sellers in different countries.

Depending on the location of users, hosting infrastructure, and service providers, personal information may be processed or stored outside the country where it was originally collected.

Where international data transfers are subject to privacy regulations, we will use the safeguards required by applicable law.

These may include appropriate contractual protections, legally recognized transfer mechanisms, and other required compliance measures.

The countries where personal information is actually stored or processed, together with the applicable safeguards, should be identified and disclosed where required.

title: Customer Privacy Rights
body:
Depending on their location and applicable law, customers and other individuals may have rights concerning their personal information.

These rights may include:

**Right of Access:** Requesting information about the personal data we hold.

**Right to Correction:** Requesting correction of inaccurate or incomplete personal information.

**Right to Deletion:** Requesting deletion of eligible personal information, subject to applicable exceptions.

**Right to Data Portability:** Receiving certain personal information in a portable format where required.

**Right to Restrict Processing:** Requesting restrictions on particular data processing activities where applicable.

**Right to Object:** Objecting to certain processing activities where the law provides this right.

**Right to Withdraw Consent:** Withdrawing previously provided consent when processing relies on consent.

**Right to Complain:** Submitting complaints to an applicable privacy or data protection authority.

To exercise available rights, contact:

support@galleriaenterprisess.com

We may require reasonable identity verification before processing requests involving personal information.

We will respond within the period required by applicable law.

title: Marketing Communications
body:
Galleria Enterprises may communicate product announcements, marketplace updates, promotional offers, and other marketing information where legally permitted.

Marketing communications may be delivered through email or other channels authorized by applicable law and user preferences.

Users may unsubscribe from promotional emails using the unsubscribe mechanism included in those messages, where available, or by contacting customer support.

Unsubscribing from promotional communications does not necessarily prevent essential transactional messages such as order confirmations, security notifications, or account-related communications.

We will seek any consent required for electronic marketing.

title: Children's Privacy
body:
Our marketplace is intended primarily for individuals who are legally permitted to use the relevant shopping and seller services.

Children should not create accounts or submit personal information without the authorization required by applicable law.

We do not intentionally collect children's personal information in violation of applicable legal requirements.

If a parent or guardian believes a child has provided personal information improperly, they may contact us to request an appropriate review and, where required, deletion.

Our procedures for age verification and parental consent will depend on applicable law and the services offered.

title: Third-Party Websites and External Links
body:
Our website may contain links to external websites, payment providers, delivery services, social media platforms, or independent sellers' websites.

These services may operate under separate privacy policies and terms.

Galleria Enterprises is not responsible for the independent privacy practices of external websites that we do not control.

Users should review the privacy policies of third-party services before submitting personal information to them.

title: Account Deletion and Personal Data Requests
body:
Users who wish to close their accounts or request changes to personal information may contact customer support or use any account management controls made available on the platform.

Upon receiving an eligible request, we will review the information involved and determine which records can be deleted, corrected, or retained.

Certain records may need to be retained for legitimate purposes, including:

- Accounting and transaction records
- Tax and regulatory compliance
- Fraud prevention
- Pending orders and refunds
- Chargeback investigations
- Legal claims or disputes

Any account deletion feature should accurately communicate the consequences of deleting an account and the types of records that may remain.

title: Automated Processing and Fraud Prevention
body:
Galleria Enterprises may use automated systems, where implemented, to support marketplace functionality, monitor suspicious activity, detect potentially fraudulent transactions, and protect user accounts.

Automated processing may involve transaction patterns, account activity, device information, or other relevant security indicators.

Where automated decisions produce legal or similarly significant effects, we will provide any notices, safeguards, or review rights required by applicable law.

We do not claim that all fraud-prevention decisions are automated.

title: Privacy Considerations for International Users
body:
We recognize that privacy requirements differ across jurisdictions.

### United States

Individuals in certain U.S. states may have additional privacy rights under applicable state laws, including rights concerning access, deletion, correction, and certain uses or disclosures of personal information.

These rights apply only where the relevant law covers our activities and the individual concerned.

Where required, we will provide additional notices, opt-out options, and procedures for exercising applicable state privacy rights.

### European Union and European Economic Area

If our processing activities are subject to the European Union General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), individuals may have additional rights and protections.

These may include rights relating to access, rectification, erasure, processing restrictions, portability, objections, and automated decision-making.

Where required, we will provide details about applicable legal bases, international transfer safeguards, supervisory authority rights, and any designated representative or data protection officer.

### United Kingdom

Where the UK GDPR and applicable United Kingdom data protection laws apply, we will provide the required privacy protections and notices.

### Other Countries

For customers and sellers in other jurisdictions, we will comply with applicable privacy and consumer protection requirements relevant to our operations.

Additional jurisdiction-specific information may be published where necessary.

title: Changes to This Privacy Policy
body:
Galleria Enterprises may periodically update this Privacy Policy to reflect:

- Changes in marketplace operations
- New products or services
- Updates to technology
- Changes in information processing
- Security developments
- New legal or regulatory requirements

When changes are made, the Last Updated date will be revised.

Where applicable law requires additional notification or consent for significant changes, we will provide it.

We encourage users to review this Privacy Policy periodically.

title: Business Transfers and Corporate Changes
body:
If Galleria Enterprises undergoes a merger, acquisition, restructuring, or sale of assets, personal information may form part of the relevant business transaction.

Any such transfer will be handled subject to applicable privacy laws and contractual obligations.

Where required, affected users will receive notice of significant changes concerning the handling of their personal information.

title: Data Accuracy and User Responsibilities
body:
Users should provide accurate and current information when registering accounts, placing orders, submitting business verification documents, or contacting support.

Users are responsible for keeping relevant account information up to date and protecting their login credentials.

Providing inaccurate contact or delivery information may affect order fulfillment or customer support.

Galleria Enterprises may request additional verification when reasonably necessary to protect accounts, investigate suspicious activity, or comply with applicable requirements.

title: Complaints and Dispute Resolution
body:
If you have concerns about how your personal information is handled, please contact our support team.

We will review privacy-related inquiries and take appropriate steps to investigate reported issues.

Where applicable law provides a right to complain to a data protection regulator or other authority, that right is not restricted by this Privacy Policy.

Nothing in this Privacy Policy limits any non-waivable rights available under applicable law.

title: Contact Information
body:
For questions about this Privacy Policy, personal information, privacy requests, account security, or data protection practices, please contact:

**Galleria Enterprises**

**Website:** https://galleriaenterprisess.com/

**Email:** support@galleriaenterprisess.com

**Business Address:** 24 Commerce Road, Fairfield, New Jersey 07004, United States

Please include enough information in your inquiry for us to understand the request. Do not send passwords, complete payment card details, or unnecessary identity documents through ordinary email.

We will address privacy-related requests according to applicable legal requirements.

title: Our Commitment to Privacy
body:
At Galleria Enterprises, customer trust and responsible information handling are important to the long-term success of our marketplace.

Our aim is to provide a reliable shopping experience while respecting the privacy of customers, sellers, and business partners.

We are committed to maintaining transparent information practices, strengthening appropriate security safeguards, and addressing legitimate privacy concerns.

**Galleria Enterprises — Your Privacy Matters.**
